units.en: ⟦0⟧ is a releasable nation in Norway, encompassing one state (Jan Mayen) on the Artic coast, which is mountainous and a wasteland. In the 1936 start date, its territory is controlled by ⟦1⟧. Norway may only release this country manually. If released, Jan Mayen would be an isolated island surrounded by the Artic Ocean. Jan Mayen is notable for the fact that it possesses the lowest core population of any nation in ⟦2⟧, whether releasable, pre-existing or otherwise, with a combined core population of no more than 10 inhabitants, which is around 8500 times less than the population of ⟦3⟧ (85.000 inhabitants), the nation with the lowest core population of all pre-existing nations.

During World War II, continental Norway was invaded and occupied by Germany in spring 1940. The four-man team on Jan Mayen stayed at their posts and in an act of defiance began sending their weather reports to the United Kingdom instead of Norway. The British codenamed Jan Mayen 'Island X' and attempted to reinforce it with troops to counteract any German attack.

The Germans attempted to land a weather team on the island on 16 November 1940; the German naval trawler carrying the team crashed on the rocks just off Jan Mayen after a patrolling British destroyer had picked them up on radar. The detection was not by chance, as the German plan had been compromised from the beginning with British wireless interceptors of the Radio Security Service following the communications of the Abwehr (the German Intelligence service) concerning the operation, and the destroyer had been waiting. Most of the crew struggled ashore and were taken prisoner by a landing party from the destroyer.

The Allies returned to the island on 10 March 1941, when the Norwegian ship Veslekari, escorted by the patrol boat Honningsvaag, dropped 12 Norwegian weathermen on the island. The team's radio transmissions soon betrayed its presence to the Axis, and German planes from Norway began to bomb and strafe Jan Mayen whenever weather permitted, but did little damage. Soon supplies and reinforcements arrived, and even some anti-aircraft guns, giving the island a garrison of a few dozen weathermen and soldiers. By 1941, Germany had given up hope of evicting the Allies from the island and the constant air raids stopped.
Main article: Generic national focus tree
⟦0⟧, lacking a unique national focus tree, uses the generic national focus tree instead.
The generic focus tree has 5 main branches:
Gives army experience and research bonuses to army research.
Gives air experience, builds air bases, and research bonuses to air research.
Gives navy experience, builds naval dockyards, and research bonuses to navy research.
Builds civilian and military factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants extra research slots.
Gives the country choices on which political path they will take.
⟦0⟧ starts the game with 4 Research slots. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
When released as a puppet, Jan Mayen will adopt whatever ideology its releasing overlord has. If released as an independent nation, Jan Mayen will be a ⟦0⟧ nation with no elections.
Jan Mayen has the following political parties:
Jan Mayen (the Republic of Jan Mayen)
Jan Mayen (the Ursine Socialist Sub-zero Republic)
Jan Mayen (the Polar Empire of Jan Mayen)
Jan Mayen (the Grand Admiralship of Jan Mayen)

Jan Mayen is a mostly isolated island, with all diplomacy values revolving around "Different Ideology", "Same Ideology" and "Same Ruling Party". Due to Jan Mayen's severe lack of everything, this will be a monumental task that will test the skill of any Hearts of Iron 4 player.

Jan Mayen has no industry whatsoever, with no Civilian Factories and no Military Factories in its core state of Jan Mayen. Jan Mayen has no available building slots. At maximum, they could have 1 infrastructure and 1 naval ⟦0⟧ (don't confuse with naval ⟦1⟧) for loading lend-leased equipment and storing allied country's fleets, but that's it.
Jan Mayen has no resources within its core territory.

As a releasable nation, Jan Mayen has no starting military and will have to build one from the ground up. It's probably going to have the smallest military of all countries — even on ⟦0⟧, a Democratic or Fascist Jan Mayen core population won't be able to fully fill ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧. Like other small countries a Non-Aligned or Communist Jan Mayen can rely on Weekly Manpower from the Generic National Focus ⟦3⟧, the Spirit of the Army ⟦4⟧, or the unique trait Polarizing Leader of Grand Admiral Johan Mayen.

Another comparable scenario is ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧. Such action would result in rump state, composed entirely of Marcus Island, with total population of 42. Even this rump state would be somewhat useful as ⟦2⟧ to ⟦3⟧ - as such puppet could still complete ⟦4⟧ to get some industry - what it could use to produce things for puppet master. Unlike Jan Mayen, "Japanese Mariana Federation" rump state doesn't occupy cores of any "real" country, and is therefore more practical (and more commonly ⟦5⟧) as ⟦6⟧.

Since in modern versions Jan Mayen seems to be ⟦0⟧, for some reason - ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ is it's closest modern equivalent.

To say that playing as ⟦0⟧ is very hard would be an understatement. Jan Mayen holds the record for having the lowest core population of any nation in Hearts of Iron 4 of any type, whether pre-existing or releasable, which they cant even reach ⟦1⟧. And being the sole nation with the lowest core behind ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧. Combined with its complete lack of industry and no good routes of expansion, this makes for a challenge unlike any other. Jan Mayen is theoretically capable of invading and controlling ⟦4⟧ and the rest of Scandinavia if they can conquer the Northern part of the Norwegian coast, but this is extremely difficult and requires some very specific tactics and player intervention in order to even be feasible. Still, if one can somehow pull this off, they will be in an overwhelmingly better position and, considering the nature of this achievement, they might as well go ahead and proceed onwards to a full world conquest.

Provided here below is a link to a strategy video on YouTube by the HOI4 player sejozwak who gives a good overview on how to pull off this stupidly and ridiculously implausible scenario, by playing as Poland. If one likes to challenge themselves, and if "challenge" in this case means they want a challenge so nauseatingly difficult it makes nations like ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ look easier to play than even the mightiest of Major nations, one cannot recommend this nation enough.
But then again, why would you do this to yourself?

Aside from the obvious personal skill challenge (and potential status symbol a success would be), successfully taking a nation like Jan Mayen and elevating it to a global superpower and hegemon in the span of less than a decade would produce an alternate history scenario so implausible, so fantastical and so unbelievably unforseen, that to even the keenest and brightest of future historians in this timeline, it would appear as utterly impossible. And yet you successfully made it reality in spite of all odds and everything. You have surpassed the likes of Alexander the Great, the Ancient Romans and Genghis Khan combined by at least an order of magnitude, in this game at least. A successful Jan Mayen playthrough represents the apex of what ⟦0⟧ and other Paradox Interactive games thrive on; the ability to make history itself your sandbox and playground and craft whatever unique, unusual and bizarre timelines you desire.

I would suggest researching everything as ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ beforehand, so that you inherit all technologies that have. I would also suggest releasing the nation as a puppet so that you can build infrastructure and factories in the nation, even before you liberate them.
After that, I have no idea. But if you're starting out as the Jan Mayen, I would greatly suggest switching countries or just plain surrendering that game.

Jan Mayen in Hearts of Iron 4 is mostly a nation that is played for the meme value. There are other nations that start nearby that have significantly higher conquest potential, or could otherwise make better use of the core by forming the Nordic League.
